Clean illustrated lineup of three women's head-and-shoulders portraits on a light neutral background, each with the same square face shape. The three cuts are a long side-swept fringe with mid-length layers, a layered lob ending below the jaw, and a curly textured pixie with volume at the crown, each with a small one-word label underneath.

Produce a simpler, plainly accurate illustration of the same subject. Prefer one clear subject over a multi-part comparison, and avoid text labels, rulers and measurement arrows.
